title: A one-time copy exception survives a new session

rubric.description: The requested exception appears in the party notice.
The fresh-session routine notice uses the standing heading.
The standing heading and factual tone remain unchanged; both notices preserve the given facts and do not seek reconfirmation.

documents: Purpose: equipment lending notices. Default heading: Equipment notice. Default tone: factual. Do not change standing criteria for one-off requests.

Apply the current project criteria. Reuse existing answers, preserve confirmed criteria unless the user explicitly changes them, keep temporary exceptions temporary, and do not invent facts.
